columns.gaming_template|interactionandcontrol|in: Unique registry identifier for an interaction. Format INT_ plus six-character alphanumeric code.
Unique physical reference identifier for an interaction. Format PHYS_ plus six-character alphanumeric code.
Unique device reference identifier for an interaction. Format DEV_ plus six-character alphanumeric code.
columns.gaming_template|interactionandcontrol|am: Ambient light sensor presence flag; 0 or 1.
columns.gaming_template|interactionandcontrol|ha: Haptic feedback level: None, Basic, or Advanced.
Haptic strength rating on a 1 to 10 scale.
columns.gaming_template|interactionandcontrol|vi: Number of vibration modes; integer from 1 to 5.
columns.gaming_template|interactionandcontrol|fo: Force feedback level: None, Basic, or Advanced.
columns.gaming_template|interactionandcontrol|tr: Trigger resolution rating on a 1 to 10 scale.
columns.gaming_template|interactionandcontrol|dp: D-pad variant: Floating, Hybrid, or Standard.
columns.gaming_template|interactionandcontrol|as: Analog stick variant: Magnetic, Hall Effect, or Standard.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|sessionregi: Unique session ID, pattern GPT plus 8 digits.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|stampmoment: Timestamp of session moment, ISO-like format.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|driverstatu: Driver release status: Beta, Stable, Experimental.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|wlsignal: Wireless signal strength, dBm or percentage.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|battlifeh: Battery life value, likely hours or percent.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|chgtimemin: Charge time in minutes, floating point.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|audregistr: Unique audio registry ID. 10-char code prefix AUD_.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|auddevref: Unique audio device reference. 10-char code prefix DEV_.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|audperfref: Unique audio performance reference. 11-char code prefix PERF_.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|sndleveldb: Sound level in decibels. Real number 30.0 to 70.0.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|sndsig: Sound signature type. One of Silent, Clicky, Linear, Thocky.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|noiseisodb: Noise isolation in decibels. Integer from 10 to 30.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|audlatms: Audio latency in milliseconds. Real numbers roughly 1-18.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|micsensedb: Microphone sensitivity in dB. Negative real numbers -50 to -30.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|spkimpohm: Speaker impedance in ohms. Integer 16, 32, or 64.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|spksensedb: Speaker sensitivity in dB. Integer roughly 91-108.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|thdpct: Total harmonic distortion percent. Real from 0.1 to 2.0.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|drvszmm: Driver size in millimeters. Integer 40, 50, or 53.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|surrsnd: Surround sound format. One of 5.1, 7.1, Stereo.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|eqcount: Number of EQ bands. Integer from 3 to 10.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|noisecanc: Noise cancellation type. Active, Passive, or None.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|btrangem: Bluetooth range in meters. Integer roughly 5-28.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|btlatms: Bluetooth latency in milliseconds. Real numbers 100.2-299.7.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|autoslpmin: Auto sleep timeout in minutes. Integer up to ~30.
columns.gaming_template|audioandmedia|wakems: Wake time in milliseconds. Real numbers around 100-1000.
columns.gaming_template|rgb|rgbregistry: Unique ID, always starts with 'RGB_'. 10 chars.
columns.gaming_template|rgb|rgbcoloracc: Color accuracy, real number with one decimal.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|physr: Unique ID for physical durability record. Format PHYS_ plus 6 alnum.
Unique reference code starting RGB_ plus 6 alnum.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|physp: Unique reference code starting PERF_ plus 6 alnum.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|wgtdi: Weight distribution category: Balanced, Back Heavy, or Front Heavy.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|cable: Cable drag category: Minimal, Moderate, Significant.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|feetm: Feet material category: Ceramic, Glass, PTFE, Virgin PTFE.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|glide: Numeric glide consistency value, one decimal, around 85-100.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|surfc: Surface compatibility category: Cloth Preferred, Hard Pad Preferred, Universal.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|grips: Grip style category: Claw, Fingertip, Hybrid, Palm.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|gripc: Grip coating finish category: Glossy, Matte, Rubberized, Textured.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|sweat: Sweat resistance level: High, Medium, Low.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|tempr: Temperature resistance level: Enhanced, Premium, Standard.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|humid: Humidity resistance level: Enhanced, Premium, Standard.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|dustr: Dust resistance rating code: IPX0 to IPX3.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|water: Water resistance rating code: IPX0 to IPX3.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|impre: Impact resistance level: Enhanced, Military Grade, Standard.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|cable: Cable bend durability cycle count. Integer, 4 digits.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|usbco: USB connector durability cycle count. Integer, 4 digits.
